subject: Integration pathway: MAP + deployment decision (hosted | dedicated | private)
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — deployment & region questions

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo on Thursday. Our engineering and security teams want to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) and an evaluation timeline so we can choose between Hosted / Dedicated / Private for production. Key constraints: PHI in a subset of data (storage residency required for EU customers), procurement needs a clear close timeline, and we need SOC2 and KMS details.

Can your team propose a short MAP with milestones showing:
- eval window (PoC -> canary -> prod)
- recommended deployment mode by milestone (fastest path + fallback)
- high-level cost and ops owner for each lane

I attached a short internal MAP template we use (ClearPath_MAP_v0.3.docx). Procurement wants an estimated close date if we proceed with Dedicated or Private.

Availability: our engineering lead Jamie (cc'd on follow-ups) prefers a call Monday or Tuesday PST.

Thanks,
Sara

--
Sara Lim
Head of Product, ClearPath Health
mailto:sara@clearpathhealth.com

Attachment: ClearPath_MAP_v0.3.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document stub)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment & region questions

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the template, that helps. Looping in Karthik (solutions/enterprise) and Priyom (security + deployments).

Quick skim / initial proposal so we have something to discuss on Monday:
- Proposed evaluation window: 3 weeks PoC (functional + ingestion), 2 weeks canary (traffic slice), 1 week final validation -> target close 2027-06-11 if we commit to Dedicated.
- Recommended path: start PoC on Hosted to accelerate integration (no infra lead time), run acceptance tests; if residency or throughput requirements mandate, pivot to Dedicated as part of the canary stage; Private (VPC/on-prem) as an alternative for regulated geofenced datasets — additional 4–6 week provisioning.
- Cost signal: hosted = fastest, lowest TTV; dedicated = predictable unit cost at commit (we'll attach a rough estimate); private = higher ops uplift.

Attachments: I will share a concise cost estimate and an evaluation checklist. Can we schedule 30 minutes Monday 10:00 AM PST to align on the MAP milestones and procurement asks?

On calls we should confirm: expected daily TPS, sample data residency footprint, and procurement lead / contract cadence.

Cheers,
Ava

--
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_eval_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@clearpathhealth.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment & region questions

Sara / Ava — quick note with concrete milestones and a hosting recommendation based on our preliminary answers from the demo.

Proposed MAP milestones (dates assume kickoff next week):
1) Week 0 (2027-05-17): Integration & sample ingestion (Hosted PoC) — Redwood provides acceptance test harness and sample SLA for token latency.
2) Week 2 (2027-05-31): Performance validation & residency analysis — if EU geofenced data > 10% of footprint, plan Dedicated or VPC segment.
3) Week 4 (2027-06-14): Canary rollout (10% traffic) — Dedicated if committed; Hosted fallback for instant failover during canary.
4) Week 6 (2027-06-28): Production cutover & SLO handoff — target close and contract sign-off for Dedicated / Private.

Recommendation summary:
- Start on Hosted to reduce time-to-value and validate integration.
- If residency/regulatory gating exists, accelerate Dedicated procurement at Week 2 so it can absorb canary by Week 4.
- Private (air-gapped or on-prem) is available but adds 4–6 weeks for engineering & security validation.

I've attached a high-level cost estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted (redwood_cost_estimate_v2.xlsx). Numbers are ballpark until we have token/day profiles. For procurement timelines: if ClearPath can commit to a 12-month Reserved Capacity by 2027-06-15 we can lock pricing and capacity.

Also: Priyom — can you confirm the SOC2 artifact and KMS flow we should share with ClearPath?

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachment: redwood_cost_estimate_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet stub)

From: Jamie Ortega <legal@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment & region questions

Hi Karthik / Ava — Jamie here from procurement/legal. A few items to confirm before we can commit to a Dedicated procurement timeline: 

1) SOC2: we need the SOC2 Type II report or SOC2 summary + timeline to full report availability.
2) KMS & key management: will keys be customer-managed (BYOK) in Dedicated / Private? We need an explanation for encryption-at-rest and KMS integration steps.
3) Data retention and egress: what tools exist for export controls and guaranteed deletion on termination?

If you can provide SOC2-summary.pdf and a short KMS note by EOD Thursday (2027-05-20), we can aim to sign a 12-month Dedicated statement of work by 2027-06-15. A Hosted-first approach is fine as a temporary measure, but procurement must see the Dedicated pricing and security artifacts to route approvals.

Thanks — copying Sara so she sees the timeline.

Regards,
Jamie Ortega
Head of Procurement, ClearPath Health
legal@clearpathhealth.com

Attachment requested: SOC2-summary.pdf (please send)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortega <legal@clearpathhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment & region questions

Jamie / team — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching the security summary and a short KMS integration note here.

Key answers (summary):
- SOC2: Redwood is SOC2 Type II certified; attached is a redacted SOC2-summary.pdf for procurement review. Full report available under NDA; we can start the NDA process in parallel.
- KMS: For Dedicated and Private we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via your KMS/HSM. For Hosted we offer a Redwood-managed KMS but can integrate with your HSM via standard key-wrapping flows. Steps: 1) exchange certs, 2) configure key policy, 3) test wrap/unwrap during canary.
- Data retention: we provide per-tenant retention controls and verified wipe procedures upon contract termination; documented in the attached retention-note.pdf.

Next steps & owners: 
- Redwood (Karthik/Priyom): provide final Dedicated pricing and SOW draft by 2027-05-20 EOD.
- ClearPath (Jamie/Sara): review SOC2-summary and KMS note; confirm procurement lead and preferred SOW template.
- All: 30-min sync Thursday 2027-05-20 09:00 AM PST to finalize the pricing and SOW cadence.

I will upload the SOW draft to DocuSign once we agree on terms — link will be shared in the MAP. HubSpot deal id: CLP-2027-0921.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security & Privacy Lead | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (stub), retention-note.pdf (stub)
